         p.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting, p.tsg_number AS tsg_number

  JOIN dk ON dk.k = mem.cr
  JOIN pk ON pk.k = mem.pack_id
  JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = pk.pid
),
cc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.id AS doc_id, s.spec AS spec, s.clause AS clause, (CASE WHEN instr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), '.') > 0 THEN substr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), 1, instr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), '.') - 1) ELSE ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#') END) AS rel

  JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id

  SELECT id AS pack_id, tsg_number AS atn FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number = 'RP-250620' OR id = 'RP-250620'

  JOIN pk ON pk.k = mem.pack_id
  JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = pk.pid
),
cc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.id AS doc_id, s.spec AS spec, s.clause AS clause, (CASE WHEN instr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), '.') > 0 THEN substr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), 1, instr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), '.') - 1) ELSE ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#') END) AS rel
  FROM (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by) md
  JOIN dk ON dk.k = md.cr
  JOIN document d ON d.id = dk.doc_id
  JOIN section s ON s.id = md.section_id
  WHERE (CASE WHEN instr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), '.') > 0 THEN substr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), 1, instr(ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), '.') - 1) ELSE ltrim(lower(trim(s.release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#') END) = (CASE WHEN instr(ltrim(lower(trim(d.target_release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), '.') > 0 THEN substr(ltrim(lower(trim(d.target_release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), 1, instr(ltrim(lower(trim(d.target_release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#'), '.') - 1) ELSE ltrim(lower(trim(d.target_release)), 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -_.#') END)
),
okd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dk.doc_id AS doc_id, di.code AS code, m.label AS wg_meeting
  FROM disposition di
  JOIN resolution r ON r.id = di.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
  JOIN dk ON dk.k = di.target
  WHERE ((lower(di.evidence_status) LIKE '%source%' AND lower(di.evidence_status) LIKE '%verif%') OR lower(trim(di.evidence_status)) = 'verified') AND lower(di.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%unverif%' AND lower(di.evidence_status) NOT LIKE '%non%verif%' AND lower(di.evidence_status) NOT LIKE 'not%' AND instr(lower(di.evidence_status), '_not') = 0 AND instr(lower(di.evidence_status), '-not') = 0 AND instr(lower(di.evidence_status), ' not') = 0
    AND (lower(di.scope) LIKE '%whole%' OR lower(di.scope) LIKE '%entire%' OR lower(di.scope) LIKE 'full%' OR lower(trim(di.scope)) IN ('document', 'doc', 'tdoc', 'all')) AND lower(di.scope) NOT LIKE '%part%'
    AND replace(replace(replace(upper(m.wg), ' ', ''), '_', ''), '-', '') IN ('RAN4', 'R4', 'RANWG4', 'WG4', 'TSGRANWG4')
),
anc AS (
  SELECT id AS pack_id, tsg_number AS atn FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number = 'RP-243057' OR id = 'RP-243057'
),
a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cp.doc_id AS doc_id, anc.atn AS atn
  FROM anc JOIN cp ON cp.pack_id = anc.pack_id
  WHERE cp.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM okd)
)
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(d.number, d.id) AS document, c.spec AS specification, c.clause AS clause
FROM a
JOIN document d ON d.id = a.doc_id
JOIN cc c ON c.doc_id = a.doc_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cc c2 JOIN cp p2 ON p2.doc_id = c2.doc_id
  WHERE c2.spec = c.spec AND c2.clause = c.clause AND c2.rel = c.rel
    AND p2.tsg_number < a.atn
)
